meta.name: ai-research-explore
meta.description: Rigor Explore compatible skill slug for meaningful and potentially novel deep learning research candidates. Use when the researcher has chosen the task family, dataset, benchmark, evaluation method, provided SOTA references, and wants candidate-only exploration on top of `current_research` with auditable repo understanding, idea gating, fair comparison, and governed experiments written to `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for README-first trusted reproduction, open-ended direction finding, narrow code-only or run-only exploration, passive repo analysis, verified novelty claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你从现有成果出发，筛选有潜力的深度学习新方向
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做研究中已有一定的对比结果，想探索新想法
copy.tagline_en: Find and vet novel deep learning research directions from your current results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have baselines and want to explore new research ideas

howto.what: 该技能使Claude在既有研究锚点上开展候选式深度学习探索:理解仓库、冻结任务与基准、生成并筛选候选想法、执行有界实验,把结果写入指定目录并生成科学变更日志和可比性报告。避免将探索结果当作已证实的复现成功。
howto.when: 当你已选定任务、数据集、基准与评估方式,备好SOTA参考,并要求在current_research基础上只做候选探索(如多种变体或实验扫描)时触发。

say.text: 基于当前 current_research,提出两个单变量候选改动并打分排序。
say.note: 会生成带分数分解的候选排序。

say.text: 固定任务、数据集、评估源和 SOTA 参考后,开始候选探索实验。
say.note: 进入受控实验流程并产出可审计结果。

howto.what_en: On a fixed research anchor, run candidate-only deep-learning exploration: freeze task/eval/benchmark, gate and rank ideas, run bounded experiments, write outputs and scientific/comparability changelogs. Novelty is a hypothesis.
howto.when_en: Trigger when task/dataset/benchmark/eval and SOTA refs are set, and candidate-only exploration on current_research is explicitly requested, e.g., variant sweep.

say_en.text: On current_research, propose and rank two single-variable candidate changes.
Freeze task/dataset/eval/SOTA, then start candidate exploration.
say_en.note: Begins governed experiment flow with auditable outputs.

say_en.text: Generate SCIENTIFIC_CHANGELOG and COMPARABILITY_REPORT for candidate runs.
